summary: Example: a local user can read another user's files through a flaw in the file service
details:
The example flaw in the system's file service lets a local user read files of another user when it opens a path with a crafted name. The system releases from 1.4.0 up to 1.4.2 have it, and so have those of the 1.3 line from 1.3.5 up to 1.3.9.1. The ripgrep app has a related flaw in every version before 14.1.1.

A machine that cannot take the fixed release has no other fix; this advisory is a fixture of system-release's tests and describes no real flaw.

database_specific.action: Update to Dukovo 1.4.2 with `update apply`, then restart.
